publication_order: verify registered ancestor descriptors and filesystem identity
fstat source and enforce owner, mode, regular-file, size, and hard-link policy
stream bytes once from descriptor while hashing into same-filesystem temporary object
fstat source again and reject any bound metadata change
publish without overwrite using atomic link or no-replace rename
fsync CAS shard directory and any newly created parent directory
reopen published object with O_NOFOLLOW and rehash
verify published digest equals object name and captured digest
append and sync ARTIFACT_CAPTURED journal event binding digest and descriptor metadata
return durable ACK only after journal commit readback

existing_object_policy.same_digest_verified: reuse immutable object after descriptor-bound rehash

crash_policy.orphan_temporary_object: non-authoritative; safely removable by separate proven policy
crash_policy.orphan_published_object_without_journal_: allowed but non-authoritative; future separately proven garbage collection only
crash_policy.journal_referenced_object: must survive recovery; absence or digest mismatch is integrity HOLD
crash_policy.ack_missing_after_journal_commit: journal-derived idempotency returns the original ACK

invariants: The journal never acknowledges governing evidence before the CAS object is durably published and reverified.
The reducer reads governing evidence by journal-bound digest from CAS, never from mutable child paths.
A path check followed by a path reopen cannot satisfy this contract.
CAS has no independent semantic authority.
